changelog: Added the 145 checks the apworld's location catalog grew by: Moogle Workshop synthesis (67 recipes), photo missions (20) and Keyblade upgrade rewards (19), the Flantastic Seven's high scores (7), and the Verum Rex / Festival Dance / Frozen Slider / Flash Tracer Course A & B minigames (32 rank abilities and item rewards). All 145 autotrack.

Added Settings toggles for the three Moogle Workshop pools (Synthesis, Photo Missions, Keyblade Upgrades), auto-synced from the seed -- these are the only new pools that can actually remove their checks, since their 'vanilla' mode drops them from the seed entirely.

Added a Maximum AP Rank setting per minigame (Junk/D/C/B/A), auto-synced from the seed. Flans and minigame checks themselves are always present: their pools only restrict what item can land there, they never remove the check.

Added map pins for the 7 Flantastic Seven flans, the 5 minigames and 15 of the 20 photo missions, each gated on its world's portal keyblade. The 5 photo missions that require photographing a specific Heartless have no pin on purpose and stay trackable from the Photo Missions overworld pin.
Keyblade upgrade checks now require the matching Keyblade, so they only light up once you actually have it.

Fixed 21 Battlegate report checks being hidden by a visibility rule pointing at a code that was never defined anywhere, which made it permanently false. They stay hidden by default -- the apworld still only implements reports 3 to 5 -- but a new 'Battlegates - Unsupported Reports' toggle reveals them if a later apworld widens that range.

Fixed The Caribbean missing its portal safety-tool requirement (Air Slide, Dodge Roll, Glide, or Blizzard) -- chests, events, Ingredients+, the Melody Chest, and the overworld pin all showed the world reachable with just the Wheel of Fate keyblade, matching the apworld's own portal rule now.

Fixed Keyblade Graveyard and Re:Mind's portal keyblades being swapped: Keyblade Graveyard now correctly requires Starlight (it was requiring Kingdom Key) and Re:Mind now correctly requires Kingdom Key (it was requiring a stale Classic Tone left over from an older apworld revision).

Default Base Abilities (Block, Dodge Roll, Pole Spin) are now auto-marked as owned when the apworld's 'Default Base Abilities' option is enabled, since those items are never sent as pickups for that slot.

Added finer-grained map auto-follow for The Caribbean's 12 islands via a new kh3_minimap_id field, ready for once the apworld client starts sending it (not yet shipped as of apworld 0.15.4 -- expected in a later client update).
Fixed the Vertical and Horizontal layouts' item panel overflowing the window (all 11 item groups stacked in one column/row); each now splits into two columns/rows.

Added Compact variants (map-focused, dropping Key Items/Classic Kingdom/Party Members) and an Optimized Horizontal variant (light and dark) that avoids the width overflow the plain horizontal layout hits at narrower window widths.

Noted apworld 0.15.4 compatibility: per-world/reward pools (Olympus, Battlegates, Re+Mind, Lucky Emblems, Keyblade Graveyard, etc.) dropped their 'vanilla' choice and can no longer exclude a world's checks from the seed, so the pack's pool-based Settings auto-sync now always leaves those checks visible, matching the apworld's own behavior; only the third-party Olympus Coliseum mod pool still has an off state.
Added Level Ups - Sora Level 51 through 99 (49 checks) tracking, matching the apworld's Level Up Limit range extending from 50 to 99.

Added Melody Chest tracking (8 checks, one per story world) for the apworld's new Music Chest Count option, including map pins and a manual toggle per world in a new 'Melody Chests' group in the Settings popup.
Fixed a Melody of Memory song staying marked as an in-progress menu check when the connected seed reassigned it to a physical Melody Chest instead.
Fixed the Music Chest Count setting's maximum showing 128 instead of the apworld's actual 0-8 range.

Added Classic Kingdom (24 checks), Olympus Coliseum (25 checks), Melody of Memory (128 checks) and Ingredients/Ingredients+ (51 + 298 checks) tracking, matching the apworld's expanded location catalog.
Added the 3 non-portal keyblades, 25 Party Member unlocks, 17 per-keyblade Style Change unlocks, and the 23 Classic Kingdom game unlocks as trackable items.
Fixed controller unlocks (Wall Run, Magic, Attraction Flow, Airstep) always showing as off on connect; autoFill was reading a slot_data key no version of the apworld has ever produced.

Fixed 11 pre-existing checks that silently never cleared because their autotracking code pointed at a location that no longer existed (San Fransokyo EVENT_009, the Always On and Unreality checks, the Rock Titan sequence-break bonus).
Fixed Melody of Memory songs with an id above 127 staying marked across seed changes.
Fixed a typo in maps.json/maps_dark.json that silently dropped a map's border thickness override.
Renamed treasure chests from their per-size label ('Olympus - Large Chest 1') to their in-game appearance order ('Olympus - Chest 29 (Large Chest, Realm of the Gods: Corridors)').
Per-world pool settings (Olympus, Toy Box, Arendelle, ...) now hide that world's checks entirely when its pool is set to vanilla, instead of only greying them out.
Regrouped the settings popup by category (Goal / World Pools / Reward Pools / Third Party Mods / Limits) instead of one long column.
Added the main controller unlocks (Style Change, Magic, Attraction Flow, Wall Run, Airstep) to the broadcast view.
Added Ultima Weapon tracking: shards count up toward the seed's Ultima Weapon Shard Count, and seeds that hand out the keyblade directly (shop, Yozora or randomized pool) fill the counter instead.
Fixed Lucky Emblem milestones appearing when only one of their two visibility conditions was met; a milestone now requires both the seed's emblem limit and the milestone progression.
Fixed the Moogle Shop pin on the dark overworld map.
Fixed the San Fransokyo event pins being misplaced on the dark map variants; they are now loaded from a variant-specific location file.
Fixed Keyblade Graveyard Small Chest 1 and Small Chest 4 being swapped on the map.
Fixed versions.json failing PopTracker's schema validation, which broke the in-app auto-updater.
Fixed some locations and check access (previously based on UT
Added various variants (horizontal and dark maps)
Fixed the San Fransokyo 'Chests 1+30' map pin (Small Chest 1 and 29) not auto-checking due to a group name mismatch between the location file and the autotracking code.

Fixed roughly 30 event/bonus locations across Olympus, Twilight Town, Toy Box, Kingdom of Corona, Monstropolis, Arendelle, San Fransokyo, The Caribbean, Keyblade Graveyard and Re Mind not auto-checking, caused by autotracking codes pointing at the wrong parent location.
Added Moogle Shop tracking.
Added the 100 Acre Wood map.
Fixed controller-unlocks autotracking.
Cleaned up the item dock UI and location layout.
Added the Caribbean Sea Map with grouped island chest/event listings.
Merged several locations across worlds.
Added second-level auto-tab-switching for autotracking.
Added a manual Settings menu to toggle Battlegates, Re:Mind, Lucky Emblems, Keyblade Graveyard and Radiant Garden, and to set the Level and Lucky Emblem limits.
Added support for Heart Pieces as an alternate victory goal alongside the 3 Proofs goal.
Extended Level Up tracking from level 35 up to level 50.
Converted Magic spells from progressive to consumable items to match in-game leveling.
Reworked the item panel: added Keyblades and World Unlocks groups, moved the Magic unlock next to World Unlocks, and merged Progression/Abilities into a single list.
Level Up and Lucky Emblem milestone checks now turn yellow once the previous tier is reachable instead of staying red until their own exact requirement is met.
Lucky Emblem milestones above the seed's configured limit, and the Battlegates/Lucky Emblems overworld map pins when disabled, are now hidden instead of shown as unreachable.
Added missing item icons for keyblades, abilities, world unlocks and settings toggles.
Fixed misaligned chest due to shifted Ids.
Fixed some misaligned checks due to shifted Ids.
Added Logic.
Added Re-Mind DLC and fixed some chests.
Added auto slot detection and data fights
Hint System established: Yellow: Useful items, Red: Trap items and Blue: Filler Items
Fixed Misaligned chests in olympus
Added overworld view
Removed unnecessary items and reworked some images
Fixed caribbean and sanfran chests as well as all stacked chests
Fixed Misaligned Toy box - Large Chest 4.
Fixed some caribbean chests.
Initial release with chest tracking for all worlds
